description_en: Configures whether to display buttons such as Approve, Cancel, and Add Approver in the DMS ticket approval area
description_zh: 调用此API可以设置DMS工单审批区域是否需要显示同意、撤销、加签等按钮
name: SetWorkflowExtraInfo

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The URL of the third-party approval flow
parameters.name: thirdparty_workflow_url

parameters.help_en: The comment on the third-party approval flow
parameters.name: thirdparty_workflow_comment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 审批流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144642.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: workflow_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display the Approve button in the DMS ticket approval area when a third-party approval flow is used to approve tickets. Valid values:

true (default): The Approve button is displayed in the DMS console.

false: The Approve button is not displayed in the DMS ticket approval area
parameters.help_zh:
使用第三方审批流程审批工单时，是否需要在DMS工单审批区域显示同意审批的按钮。取值如下：

true（默认）：表示当DMS界面会显示同意按钮。

false：表示DMS工单审批区域不会出现同意按钮
parameters.name: render_agree

parameters.help_en:
